title: Musical Agent Systems: MACAT and MACataRT
abstract: arXiv:2502.00023v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Our research explores the development and application of musical agents, human-in-the-loop generative AI systems designed to support music performance and improvisation within co-creative spaces. We introduce MACAT and MACataRT, two distinct musical agent systems crafted to enhance interactive music-making between human musicians and AI. MACAT is optimized for agent-led performance, employing real-time synthesis and self-listening to shape its output autonomously, while MACataRT provides a flexible environment for collaborative improvisation through audio mosaicing and sequence-based learning. Both systems emphasize training on personalized, small datasets, fostering ethical and transparent AI engagement that respects artistic integrity. translated_title: 音乐代理系统：MACAT 与 MACataRT
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.00023v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们的研究探索了音乐代理的开发与应用，这是一种人机回环生成式人工智能系统，旨在支持共同创作空间中的音乐表演和即兴演奏。我们引入了 MACAT 和 MACataRT 两种不同的音乐代理系统，它们专为增强人类音乐家与人工智能之间的互动音乐创作而设计。MACAT 针对代理主导的表演进行了优化，利用实时合成和自我监听来自主塑造其输出；而 MACataRT 则通过音频镶嵌和基于序列的学习，为协作即兴演奏提供了灵活的环境。这两个系统都强调在个性化的小型数据集上进行训练，促进尊重艺术完整性的道德和透明人工智能参与。本研究凸显了交互式、以艺术家为中心的生成式人工智能如何拓展创作可能性，使音乐家能够实时探索新的艺术表达形式。
tldr: 本文介绍了 MACAT 和 MACataRT 两种音乐代理系统，通过个性化小数据训练和实时交互，促进人机协作的音乐表演与即兴创作，强调透明且尊重艺术完整性的 AI 参与。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two musical agent systems, MACAT and MACataRT, which use personalized small-data training and real-time interaction to enhance human-AI collaborative music performance and improvisation, emphasizing transparent and artistically respectful AI engagement.
